chunks: Ibrāhīm ibn ʿUqbah wrote to him: “We have socks and waistbands made from rabbit fur. Is salat (prayer) permissible in them without necessity and without taqiyyah?” So he, peace be upon him (AS), wrote: “Salat (prayer) in them is not permissible.”
ai.seo_question: Is salat (prayer) valid in clothing made from rabbit fur without necessity or taqiyyah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that salat (prayer) is not permissible in garments made from rabbit fur when there is neither necessity nor taqiyyah. It addresses practical questions of dress in worship and reflects jurisprudential concern for valid prayer attire.
